notes: This patch release changes only the exact native dependency, from bifrost.public.packs 0.8.0 to 0.9.0, which adds compiled the last six packs Bifrost's legacy embedded registry provided: bifrost.java.lombok, bifrost.rust.getset, bifrost.scala.case-class, bifrost.python-process-inputs, bifrost.node-runtime-values-javascript and bifrost.node-runtime-values-typescript. Bifrost 0.15.1 no longer falls back to embedded packs, so normal acquisition through the rules stream needs this dependency to supply them (bifrost-dev#4438). Policies, IDs and consumer requirements are unchanged from rules 0.9.0: it requires Bifrost 0.15.0 or later, which is also what packs 0.9.0 needs to read its index schema 4 bundle. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
